verdicts.reason: A reads left to right with a strong 'Pygmalion' headline, but the orange wash has shrunk to an odd vertical strip mid-banner, the presenter line is wrapped into a tiny one-word-per-line stack, the white frame is reduced to a stray stub, and the oversized play arrows compete with the headline. B is worse: everything is jammed into a small centre stack with tiny text, the reading order is jumbled (tickets above presenter, credit squeezed beside the arrows), an empty orange box floats on the left, and both sides are left as dead space.
